note: The ground-floor repair workshop: adjectives of state 1 (damp, fragile, clean, intact, endless...). Adjectives have no gender (divider null). The glazed door on the left opens back onto the square in front of the building; the open doorway on the right leads on into the repair café.

old man frowning at a tangled diagram
child in red wellies splashing in a puddle
old shoe with a hole worn through
king sneezing on a dusty old throne
cat, dog and rabbit dusting the shelf with feather dusters
swan with perfectly groomed white feathers
